architecture.title: Architecture & Data Isolation Guarantees
architecture.description: How the Core SaaS platform handles multi-tenancy and database routing behind the scenes.
architecture.shared_desc: Tenants share a unified PostgreSQL database pool. Every database operation is automatically scoped with the active tenant ID extracted from HTTP header
architecture.dedicated_desc: The dynamic router resolves the tenant record and acquires an isolated connection pool using the tenant's custom DSN configuration, with automated idle pool reaping.
